title: Power Systems Support (Generators & UPS)
description: Installation, maintenance, and lifecycle support for critical power and backup systems.

bodies.heading: Power that does not fail
bodies.lede: Installation, maintenance and lifecycle support for generators, UPS and critical backup power. We keep continuous power behind radar sites, operations centres, workshops and infrastructure — with scheduled maintenance, accurate diagnosis, professional repair and the spare parts to back it up.
